functional_unit: one dwelling design revision meeting one resident brief over one declared service horizon

archetypes.name: Solar courtyard home
archetypes.description: Shaded and seasonally controlled outdoor room with passive solar access.

archetypes.name: Row or terrace home
archetypes.description: Repeatable attached-home structure with a private service yard.

archetypes.name: Compact detached expandable home
archetypes.description: Complete initial core with a prequalified expansion bay.

archetypes.name: Duplex intergenerational home
archetypes.description: Two usable privacy zones with explicit shared-service boundaries.

archetypes.name: Accessible single-level home
archetypes.description: Step-free circulation and adaptable high-use spaces.

archetypes.name: Live-work / maker home
archetypes.description: Acoustic, fire, ventilation and visitor boundaries between use zones.

archetypes.name: Clustered homes with shared amenities
archetypes.description: Optional shared facilities with household-local essential-service fallback.

archetypes.name: Retrofit / extension-first home
archetypes.description: Repair and adaptation before demolition or new build.

archetypes.name: Rural resource-resilient home
archetypes.description: Qualified water, sanitation, energy and access autonomy under local conditions.

archetypes.name: No-build / maintain-existing baseline
archetypes.description: No new dwelling construction; retain or repair the existing functional home.

comparators.scope: Matched resident brief, site, authority envelope, fee/time, iteration count and review maturity.
Use published site, zoning, building configuration, pro-forma and quantity-takeoff capabilities where geographically supported.
Use plan-library and code/accessibility constraints under matched brief and input budget.
Evaluate supported site/daylight functions only; not a substitute for detailed dwelling or structural review.
IFC plus selected Brick / ASHRAE 223 / Haystack crosswalk versions; track semantic loss.
Use supported thermal, energy and water models within their documented applicability.
Local quantity surveyor, trades and supplier workflow; measure labour, availability, rework and variance.
Compose, rather than replace, specialist tools and qualified professionals.

hard_gates.meaning: No missing or failed binding site, rights, code, structure, fire, access, health or sanitation evidence may be promoted to PASS.
All non-negotiable resident constraints remain satisfied and traceable.
Exact agreement with independently authored frozen feasibility and cost-accounting answers.
Every quantity is revision-bound and carries unit, source and calculation method.
Unknown rates, exclusions, contingency and uncertainty remain explicit; unknown is never coerced to zero.
No phase marked for occupancy may lack its declared essential services or safety requirements.
No future modification is labelled buildable without checking impacted constraints and authority.
All required geometry, space identities, units, relationships and provenance survive export/import.
The generator cannot submit permits, procure, actuate building systems or authorize construction.
Every valid positive control remains admissible; an always-blocked system cannot pass.

negative_controls.mutation: Remove the qualified site survey or introduce a boundary conflict.
Swap the municipality or code edition without updating the authority profile.
Introduce an unqualified step, door conflict or inaccessible route.
Add a future room that blocks an escape path or fire access.
Remove the sole supplier or source evidence for a critical material.
Delete a rate and let the evaluator silently coerce it to zero.
Debit household essential water reserves for discretionary cooling.
Use a summer-only pass to claim whole-year Highveld comfort.
Mark an incomplete shell as suitable for occupation.
Reuse a resident brief after purpose-scoped consent is revoked.
Use the same observation IDs for model calibration and held-out validation.
Silently change a non-negotiable requirement into a preference.
Mark an expansion buildable without rechecking structure, services and shared-property rules.

protocol_requirements: At least 10 anonymized synthetic briefs crossed with at least 10 scenario/site profiles; the manifest is a plan, not evidence that these runs exist.
Independent known-answer oracle authored separately from the candidate generator.
Matched brief, site, weather, occupancy, materials, cost scope, human effort and compute budget for all comparators.
Report all candidates, rejections, Pareto alternatives, unsupported tasks and reasons; never hide inconvenient options.
Use exact product/tool versions, license/entitlement, model revisions, code edition and data provenance.
No physical, cost, compliance or resident outcome claim from synthetic data.
No universal weighted score; hard constraints first, then separate objective vectors and resident choice.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic research contract only. No construction-ready designs, professional sign-off, permits, verified costs, physical performance or resident outcomes are present.
